label: Bible Study
prompt: For I have given you an _____, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verse: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
note: After washing the disciples' feet, Jesus called it an example — do as I have done.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Finally, my brethren, be _____ in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verse: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
note: Just before the armour of God comes the pep talk: be strong in the Lord — in His might, not yours.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than _____, they were stronger than lions.
verse: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan: swifter than eagles, stronger than lions, and not divided in death.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They fought from heaven; the stars in their _____ fought against Sisera.
verse: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
note: From Deborah's victory song: even the stars joined the battle against Sisera, along with a flash flood.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire _____!
verse: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
note: James on the tongue: a tiny member, a big boast — 'how great a matter a little fire kindleth!'
